adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, the new code does `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? [];` and then immediately accesses `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration` without optional chaining. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`/`undefined` or an empty array, `mainHostDestinationCalendar` is `undefined` and `.integration` will throw a `TypeError`. This is a regression from the old safe check `evt.destinationCalendar?.integration !== "google_calendar"`, and the diff shows several call sites can set `destinationCalendar` to `null` or `[]` (e.g. `handleNewBooking` sets it to `null` when none; other paths set `[]`).
